task.title: Create an Order Verification Workflow
task.shortdesc: The Order Verification Workflow automatically validates scanned items against order specifications from Shopify or other eCommerce platforms. This workflow ensures accuracy and creates an audit trail of verified orders before shipment.

ul.li: You must have Admin or Custom User role
You must be logged into AuditX Forge
At least one site must be created and assigned to a system
Event URL Report feature must be enabled in Settings
If using Shopify integration: Shopify store name and API access key
For webhook integration: Webhook must be pre-configured

context.p: The Order Verification Workflow is designed for eCommerce fulfillment operations. It links video evidence directly to order verification data, creating a complete record of what was packed and validated against the order.
context.note: Before creating this workflow, ensure Event URL Report is enabled in Settings. See "Enable Event URL Reports" for instructions.

step.cmd: Navigate to the "Workflows" menu in the left-hand navigation of AuditX Forge
Click the "Add Workflow" button on the right side of the screen
step.info: The workflow creation form will load.

substep.cmd: Enter a descriptive name for your workflow

ul.li: Example: "Shopify Order Verification - Main Warehouse"
Example: "Ecommerce Order Validation - Zone A"

substep.cmd: Select the site where this workflow will operate
substep.info: Choose from your list of previously created sites.

substep.cmd: Optionally add a description of the workflow's purpose

step.cmd: Select "Order Verification" from the "Use Case" dropdown menu
step.info: This identifies the workflow type and determines available configuration options.

step.cmd: Choose the platform for integration (Shopify, WMS, or Custom)

ul.li: Shopify: Direct integration with Shopify orders
WMS: Integration with Warehouse Management System
Custom: Custom order database or manual order entry

info.p: Barcode Commands allow operators to control recording start/stop and capture using predefined barcodes:

ul.li: Scan <<stop>> barcode to end recording
Scan <<capture>> barcode to take a snapshot

info.note: Enable this only if your operation uses special control barcodes. Most operations can skip this step.

step.cmd: Click "Next" to proceed to Additional Settings

ul.li: This represents the type of barcode being scanned
Examples: "Item Code", "SKU", "Product ID", "Order ID"
Use the Min slider to set minimum barcode length
Use the Max slider to set maximum barcode length
This helps reject invalid or incomplete scans

substep.info: This removes invisible ASCII characters that some barcode scanners add to scans, preventing scanning errors.

info.p: Group barcodes into custom categories using regular expressions:

ul.li: Click "Add RegEx" to create a new classification rule
Enter a regular expression pattern (e.g., ^[0-9]{12}$ for 12-digit codes)
Enter a Classification Name (e.g., "Standard EAN")
Click Save to add the rule
Standard: Broader compatibility with most video players
Advanced: Higher compression, smaller file sizes, requires modern codec support

substep.cmd: Enter your Shopify API access key
substep.info: Obtain this from your Shopify Admin dashboard under Apps and Integrations.

step.cmd: Click on the "Event Configuration" section to expand it
Configure Static Event Information (annotations that appear on video)

info.p: Select which metadata should be displayed on the recorded video:

ul.li: Event ID: Unique identifier for each event
Barcode ID: The actual scanned barcode value
Timestamp: Date and time of recording
System Name: Name of the AuditX device that recorded

info.note: Select at least Event ID and Timestamp for traceability.

ul.li: Sub-Event Markers: Visual indicators showing where individual SKUs were scanned during video
Weight Data: Display of package weight at relevant moments in video

info.p: If enabled, select annotation size (Small, Medium, or Large).
This captures still images for each barcode scan during packing:

ul.li: Check "Capture Image" to enable automatic snapshot at each scan
Check "Annotate Image" to add metadata to captured images
Choose 3 minutes or 5 minutes maximum per video session
Events longer than this will be segmented into multiple recordings
4K: Highest quality, larger file size
1080p (Full HD): Standard quality, smaller file size

info.p: Define what happens when your AuditX credit balance is depleted:

ul.li: Stop Progress: Halt all recording immediately
Overwrite: Continue recording by replacing oldest events first (FIFO)

step.cmd: Review all workflow settings for accuracy
step.info: Scroll through the form to verify all configurations are correct.

step.cmd: Click the "Save" button to create the workflow
step.info: The system will validate all settings and save the workflow.

result.p: Your Order Verification Workflow has been successfully created and is now active. The workflow is ready to process orders and validate scanned items against your order database.

ul.li: Assign the workflow to a Config Group (see "Create Config Groups")
Assign the Config Group to an AuditX device (see "Assign Config Group to System")
Test the workflow with a sample order to verify operation
If using Shopify integration, verify orders appear in the system
Monitor reports to confirm events are being recorded correctly

dlentry.dt: Shopify orders not appearing in system
dlentry.dd: Verify your Shopify store name and API key are correct. Check that Event URL Report is enabled. Allow 5-10 minutes for initial sync.
Check barcode length range settings. Verify scanner is not adding extra characters. Enable "Suppress Control Characters" if needed.
Check network connection quality. Try lowering resolution to 1080p if 4K fails. Verify camera lens is clean.
Verify workflow is assigned to a Config Group. Confirm Config Group is assigned to the system. Check system status is "Active".
